basis: XML 1.0 and Namespaces 1.0 ordered documents carried in UTF-8 with SignCell source evidence.

cases.claim: Malformed markup and namespace failures produce diagnostics and refuse conversions.
cases.test: malformed markup and namespace failures are truthful check results but refused conversions
